fees.literal_quote: |maker_fee_rate|string|false|none|Maker fee rate, negative values indicate rebates| |taker_fee_rate|string|false|none|Taker fee rate|
fees.discounts_separate: Current public contract market fields are maker_fee_rate=-0.0001, taker_fee_rate=0.00075 for BTC/ETH. Authenticated GET /futures/{settle}/fee is documented as market trading fee query. Account/base-tier/API applicability unresolved.
fees.unresolved: Ordinary base-tier API fee not proven publicly; do not treat per-contract field or generic website fee as account API rate.

funding.history_depth: recent BTC/ETH records retrieved; 2024-10-13 from rejected with 180-day limit

data.pagination: GET /futures/usdt/candlesticks from/to seconds, max 2000 points/query, recent 10000-point window observed
data.closure: t is candle timestamp seconds; no completed flag verified, filter by clock
data.trades: public trades endpoint documented; history depth unverified
data.mark_index: mark_/index_ candle prefixes and premium_index documented; history depth unverified
data.oi_history: GET contract_stats open_interest current samples succeeded; history depth unverified

metadata.change_history: API changelog and current config_change_time field; exact historical values not recovered

execution.client_order_id: order text custom ID t- prefix, <=28 additional bytes; pending-order query support; strict idempotency unverified
execution.queries: GET orders/orders_timerange, trades, positions documented; private calls not probed
execution.status_feed: API changelog and announcements pages; operational status feed unverified
execution.rate_limits: response X-Gate-RateLimit-* headers; futures order endpoints 100 requests/second documented, per endpoint limits vary
execution.signing: APIv4 HMAC SHA512 key/secret; key permissions by business category and read/write; no credentials used
execution.custody: centralized exchange account USDT futures collateral

quotes.contract_unit: The contract multiplier indicates how many units of the underlying asset the face value of one contract represents.
quotes.candle: Maximum of 2000 points are returned in one query. Be sure not to exceed the limit when specifying `from`, `to` and `interval`
quotes.old_error: Candlestick too long ago. Maximum 10000 points recently are allowed
quotes.isolated: leverage ≠ 0: Isolated Margin Mode (Regardless of whether cross_leverage_limit is filled, this parameter will be ignored)
quotes.reduce_only: Set as `true` to be reduce-only order
quotes.permissions: you can create one key with spot read/write and futures read/write permission which can be used in both spot and futures trading.

limitations: Two-year old BTC/ETH native M15 requests rejected with 10000 recent point limit; no official archived M15 retrieved.
